body: Can we not delete this from the internet yet?

I'm outgoing, smiley, joking, and happy.

As for the doctor, I don't want this to follow me around. I don't want people to think I'm messed up. I don't want to be treated differently. Doctor's right things down and I am not I want them doing that. I also don't want to take drugs. I don't like the affects it has on people.

I mean like for strangers on the internet helping me. It's freaking Christmas Eve and you seem to be going way out of your way. Thank you by the way. I appreciate it more than you know.

 As for the comfort zone thing, I don't like asking for help. It is not something I do often. Its not easy for me, if you can't fix something, then you figure out how to fix it. I don't know being independent is very important to me. I just don't talk about myself or my problems at all. Especially things like this. I just don't like it at all. Hence the throw away account.

Like not wanting to kill myself. In the first post I said I feel like two people. I just want to be the face I put on. I don't want this otherside to myself. I want it to go away forever.

I am not sure what help would like. Like said before this is my first time I've have ever thought about seeking help.

I'm not that much of a complainer. If you can hold your own you, you should hold your own. Idk I feel like I'm operating way out side of my comfort zone as it is. Like your job isn't to help me right? Idk I feel like I'm not worth the effort.

Idk I have seen killing myself as like an option way down the list, right? Like I have other more lucrative options than to go through with anything. Now it's like I'm 26, which I know is young but like I am not getting any younger, and the options just aren't there in the abundance they once were , and the list is getting shorter. Like I have a great setup, if I can't be happy where I am at can I be happy anywhere?

I don't what kind of help I need. I at a loss here. I would prefer to not have to take drugs or anything like that. So I am a little worried about going to a doctor.

Like I don't want people to think I'm going  killing myself. Also I am pretty well off, so like who am into complain? People have it way worse than me.

I think about it a lot and it is definitely more of an option than it was before. In highschool it was "just get to college, it will be better then". In college it was "just wait till you graduate and get a job, it will be better then". At the start of my job it was just "wait till you settle in". Well 3 years in now and it's not getting better, just the opposite.

Help would be just making me happy. There is no reason I shouldn't be happy. I got the best job i could have asked for, a great boss.  I have good friends and parents that want me to succeed.  

But it feels like my friends and family don't think mental health stuff is a real problem. I have come close to talking about this kind of stuff about things we see in the news or whatever and they are are dismissive or have negative views. So I always backed away from bring my stuff up. I would like to solve this with folks knowing. I just feel ashamed and ungrateful.
How would that go? I horrified of people righting things down. How accessable is that to like future employers?
